xml_content: <TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex8012023-01-2014-49-18" status="finalized"><note type="gloss"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:5534">dul lha</rs> dang |  <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:5550">shan ti pa</rs> dang <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3786">lo tsa ba</rs> ltar na</note> dang po la lnga ste | 'gal bas khyab pa dmigs pa'i rtags dgod pa dang | don las don dang 'dra ba skye ba dang ¦ don yang ming <lb n="2a5"/> 'brel pa <abbr>med</abbr> pa dang ¦ ming 'dzin <note type="gloss">ming snang pa tsaM gyi spyi rigs</note> pa la don dang 'brel <note type="gloss">par snang</note> pas khyab pa<note type="gloss">s rang gi mtshan nyid kyi ming snang yang</note> <abbr>gsum</abbr> gyis ming don <note type="gloss">dang</note> ma 'brel bas don las skye bas <note type="editorial">A scribal note in dbu can corrects the reading to "skyes pa la"</note> ming mi snang pas khyab pa dang | shugs la grub pa <choice><orig>yul la °°°</orig><reg>yul la</reg></choice> ltos pa'i sbyor ba dang ¦ dngos su bstan pa yul can la ltos pa'i sbyor ba <abbr>gnyis kyis</abbr> skabs kyi don bsdu ba dang | sgra don bdag cig kyang don las skye ba la ming mi snang pas khyab pa dang | zhar la rnaM rtog srid pa'i yul yid kyi rnaM shes yin pa'o</seg></TEI>
